title: DeepSeek open-sourced an agent that runs your repo

hooks.text: DeepSeek just open-sourced an agent that runs your GitHub repo on its own. 21 thousand stars in about a week.
What if your repo had a teammate that only spoke when you had to decide something?
This agent opens its own work items and answers with pull requests.

verified_claims: Repo deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype created 2026-10-31, MIT license, 21,004 stars on 2026-11-08
README: research prototype for reference only, not an official DeepSeek product
Proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness; listens to GitHub and optionally Feishu

When someone allowed asks for work it opens a work item, works in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request; a web panel shows what needs a person
Principle: take as little human attention as possible, give as much value as possible; acts only when asked or when a team-written rule allows, speaks only when someone must act or can use a result
Setup is driven by a coding agent reading SETUP.md, one short question at a time; pnpm check runs typecheck, tests and build
notes: Metadata and README fetched with gh api on 2026-11-08.
